narratives.body: ESPN discusses AC Milan's stance on a fan boycott regarding 'excessive' away ticket prices. FOX Sports discusses AC Milan's warning of potential retaliation over the boycott.
narratives.headline: AC Milan addresses fan boycott over ticket prices

narratives.body: LiveScore discusses Milan's fear of a lengthy lay-off for Chukwueze and the possibility of Athekame's January return. OneFootball discusses the likelihood of AC Milan recalling Athekame in January.
narratives.headline: Milan's injury concerns and Athekame recall speculation

narratives.body: TribalFootball discusses AC Milan's eagerness to secure Rabiot's future with a fresh contract.
narratives.headline: AC Milan seeks new contract for Rabiot
